_comment: FIXTURE — curated agent registry for Leafcutter Atlas mock mode (UXP-551). A realistic subset of the real config/agent_registry.json, sufficient to populate /pipeline and /architecture views.

agents.name: Ticket Supervisor
agents.role: Depth-0 ticket orchestrator — dispatches phase agents in sequence.
agents.description: Drives a single ticket through its phase agents. Reads the frontmatter agents: map, spawns the next needed agent, parses the resulting Comments status tag, and routes on ok / handoff / blocker / question.

agents.name: Test Writer
agents.role: TDD test-first authoring agent — priority 5 in ticket-supervisor dispatch.
agents.description: Writes failing test stubs before any coder runs. Captures a structured red_baseline block and hands off to coders whose job is to make the red-baseline green.

agents.name: Python Coder
agents.description: Writes, edits, and refactors Python code while automatically pulling in project conventions and running doc-enforcer + complexity-reduction before declaring the task done.

agents.name: Frontend Coder
agents.description: Writes, edits, and refactors HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue, Svelte, and other web-layer files. Embeds design principles directly.

agents.name: PR Reviewer
agents.role: Pre-PR self-review against the working diff — priority 11.
agents.description: Classifies every finding into high / medium / low confidence and surfaces only high-confidence issues.

agents.name: Commit
agents.description: Shows the planned commit message and file list before issuing git commit. On pre-commit hook failure, invokes the precommit-autofix skill and retries once.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.role: Central context-gathering hub for cross-file lookups.
agents.description: Accepts a structured question from a parent agent, searches the codebase or documentation, and returns curated findings with file paths and a synthesis paragraph.

agents.name: Documentation Expert
agents.description: Classifies a write-or-update-doc request by intent and dispatches to the matching specialist sub-agent.
